start.authority: Coordinating agent authorised original-file upload and explicit local voice capture UI against the new synthetic backend. No live microphone, external processing or test execution by this worker.
start.outcome: An advocate may supply original files or an explicitly recorded voice note without inventing or typing a placeholder case narrative; receipt never means admission, reading, verified authority or established fact.
start.inputs: Existing shared api/state/showThreadBoard and nm:session-ended/nm:matter-changed events; UploadService served receipt contract verified in nm/edge/uploads.py, nm/domain/intake.py and nm/edge/api.py. The coordinator moved the byte-handling service from core to edge without exempting the reasoning-boundary sweep.

contract.entry: Authenticated current context, explicit supplied purpose, authority statement and retention selection; no automatic consent or defaults.
contract.does: Serial bounded chunks, SHA-256 identity, server-receipt reconciliation, honest cancellation, local record/pause/stop/playback, prompt media-track and object-URL cleanup.
contract.never: No unsolicited microphone, background egress, browser persistence of client material, arbitrary server preview, scanner/OCR/transcription claim or legal fact promotion.
contract.refuses: Empty/oversized files, unknown context, incomplete decisions, mismatching reselected file, stale response, unknown receipt or unsupported recording capability.
contract.recovers: Retain stable attempt keys only in current authenticated in-memory UI; reopen reads server receipts and requires exact file/hash/size identity before continuing at observed_size. Cancellation does not imply deletion of accepted bytes.

start.proof_intent: New journey tests use real served browser uploads with synthetic files and fake microphone only where explicit permission/capture is exercised. Original-byte storage, resumed digest/offset and no narrative turn are inspected; UI signals and logout cleanup are judged live.
exclusions: No extraction/scanner/OCR/transcription engine or original-download approval
No app.js/app.css changes, shared registry changes or test execution
No localStorage/sessionStorage or live user media

build.implementation: One current-context receipt/capture dialog. File-only openings use a supplied filename/title, never a model turn. SHA-256 identity and server-observed offsets govern serial encrypted-store receipt. Explicit instructions remain user assertions; the UI discloses withheld processing and unimplemented automatic retention. Session/view generations and receipt-read generations prevent stale responses from reviving protected or superseded state. Recorder callbacks are owned by their capture; stopped recorders cannot stop a later one.
build.safety_review: Bounded local files and capture; explicit microphone action; in-memory attempt identity only; unsupported or unconfirmed operations remain withheld. Close/session end abort sending, release microphone tracks, revoke playback URLs and clear local selections. Acceptance or pause/cancel does not claim deletion, scanning, extraction, admission or established facts. The independent follow-up review found and fixed self-consistent crossed receipt IDs: every existing-asset response must also match the caller's requested asset, so a returned ID cannot change the next chunk target.
build.limitations: No independent test run or browser observation by this worker. No full P16 completion or external assurance claim. Existing app/backend owners must freeze shared sources before recording browser identity evidence.
